heading: Shareable Campaign Pages
content: Tell your story, share what you need — whether it's cash, food, clothes, or medicine. Supporters see your cause and decide how they can help.

heading: One-Tap Help Requests
content: When someone's already agreed to help, a manager sends a payment request with one tap. The supporter confirms with their PIN — no hassle, no friction.

heading: Supporter Pool (CRM)
content: Keep track of every person who cares about your cause — their consent, their history, whether they gave cash or dropped off items. Everything in one place.

heading: Money & Things Help
content: Raise money and coordinate donated items on the same Campaign. One place for community support — cash, clothes, food, books, equipment, whatever is needed.

heading: Real Receipts & Updates
content: Every supporter gets an instant receipt and a progress update after they help. They see exactly how their contribution made a difference.

heading: Built-In Security
content: Changia never sees or stores your mobile-money PIN. Every payment is processed through the secure gateway you already trust.
